no_adcom_quote.quote: Advisory Committee:** RelistorTM was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the safety profile of the product did not pose unique concerns beyond those applicable to other opioid receptor antagonists that are approved and marketed in the U.S. In addition, the primary endpoint, rescue-free laxation response, was non-controversial, and RelistorTM was clearly superior to placebo. Therefore, the benefit-risk profile was favorable for the indicated patient population.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for RELISTOR (NDA021964). The Summary Review, Office/Division Director memo, and approval letter each state the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the product is a member of the already-approved opioid receptor antagonist class and posed no unique safety concerns, the primary endpoint (rescue-free laxation) was non-controversial, and efficacy was clearly superior to placebo. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm concerns linked to changes in the approval.
